_meta.description: Insurance-shaped seeded estate for validating the Insurance template. Claims handling, underwriting review and policy servicing on Service Cloud.
_meta.shape: STRUCTURALLY IDENTICAL to discovery/ingest/fixtures/salesforce_sample.json — the same keys discovery.ingest.salesforce.ingest() returns, so this seed drives the REAL Service Cloud detector inputs rather than a parallel test-only shape. Only the values are insurance-flavoured.
_meta.why_a_test_fixture: Nothing in production loads this. It exists to prove AC1 — that an untouched Insurance-template run produces findings from EXISTING detectors on an insurance-shaped estate — so it lives with the test that asserts it rather than pretending to be a shipped offline source.

workflow_areas.claims_handling: Claim FNOL, status enquiry and settlement records; owner changes across claims teams supply the handoff signal.
workflow_areas.underwriting_review: Underwriting Referral Review approvals with real dwell; the referral queue is the review bottleneck.
workflow_areas.policy_servicing: Endorsement, cancellation, certificate and billing requests — the repeat servicing workload.

detectors_expected_to_fire: REPETITIVE_AUTOMATION — repeat policy-service requests over a high-volume flow surface
KNOWLEDGE_GAP — few claims/policy cases linked to knowledge
INTEGRATION_CONCENTRATION — Policy Admin System referenced by 4 flows (>= 3)
PERMISSION_BOTTLENECK — underwriting referral concentrated on 2 approvers (bottleneck_score 37.0 >= 10.0)
CROSS_SYSTEM_ECHO — claims duplicated into the workflow system (0.2286 >= 0.15)
negative_controls: Policy Endorsement Approval: bottleneck_score 3.6 and avg_delay_days 2.1 — below both approval thresholds, so it must not drive the finding.
Rating Engine: flow_reference_count 1 — below the integration-concentration threshold of 3.
_meta.not_evidence_of_correctness: Authored, not captured from a real insurance org. It proves the template and the existing detectors work together on an insurance-shaped estate; it does not prove any threshold is calibrated for insurance.
_meta.org_type: Enterprise Service Cloud — general insurance (claims + policy servicing + underwriting referral)
